purpose: derive one bilateral review-only +X latch-lever articulation from the exact existing lower lever and front-service-panel proof geometry, preserving source and ownership identity while measuring when the moving lever proof volume separates from the fixed lid-owned keeper proof volume

continuous_certificate.claim: once the rotated lever maximum Z falls below the keeper minimum Z, the exact axis-aligned keeper and rigid rotated lever proof volumes stay Z-separated through the 50 degree review endpoint
continuous_certificate.not_claimed: full physical latch release, hook/capture behavior, force, spring behavior, panel collision freedom or arbitrary-angle mechanism validity

truth_boundary: PASS means only that this exact derived bilateral rigid-lever rig candidate preserves source/ownership identity, pivot fixation and rigid shape, reproduces the closed overlap at 0 degrees, and reaches continuous keeper proof-volume Z separation before the exact 50 degree review endpoint. It does not prove a real latch hook or retention mechanism, manufacturing, loads, wear, panel/fastener/full-mesh collision freedom, animation timing, controller/runtime behavior, gameplay or visual acceptance.
